text:
amy: Need exec help — NovaHealth POC is stuck. They're blocking on VPC peering + BYO KMS + legal questionnaire. Customer wants a decision by EOD Tue. Pulling in folks here so we can unblock quickly.

mike: Quick status from SE side: peering works from our infra. Waiting on NovaHealth to confirm their firewall rules and static routes. They specifically asked for our peerable ranges and allowed ports.

sarah: Peering IPs we can hand off: 10.200.0.0/22 (egress) and 10.201.0.0/24 (management). Allow outbound 443 and 5222 (if they want push notifications). @mike i'll drop a sample ACL.

sarah: ```
# example firewall snippet for NovaHealth
allow tcp from 10.201.0.0/24 to 10.200.0.0/22 port 443
allow tcp from 10.201.0.0/24 to 10.200.0.0/22 port 5222
# route their peering CIDR to our peering endpoint: pe-0123456789abcdef
```

raj: BYO KMS asks — legal/security needs KMS attestation and HSM cert chain. Also they want to confirm key-import flow (we don't keep copies). I can put together a short attestation and the integration checklist for their CISO. We will need the customer's KMS endpoint and supported algorithms.

amy: They also pushed on pricing: customer asked for ~50% off committed 3-month capacity. Not sure we can go that deep. @jessica — can you advise what we can approve from sales exec?

jessica: We can do 30% on a 6-month commit, 40% on an annual. For a 3-month term i can approve up to 35% if we get exec signoff and legal ok. If they need 50% we'd need a special approval from the CRO. Timeline matter — need a signed LOI by Tue to consider the 35%.

mike: Legal questionnaire pieces I saw: data residency, cache eviction TTLs, and token logging. Short answers: all customer content stored in their selected region, KV cache TTL configurable (default 24h), and we do not log raw customer payloads — we log metadata/trace ids for debugging. I'll paste short Q/A for the security form.

mike: "Q: Where is customer data stored?" -> "A: Data is stored in the customer's chosen region; backups abide by regional controls and are encrypted at rest."

mike: "Q: Can we use BYO KMS?" -> "A: Yes. We support BYO KMS via our customer-managed key integration. We do not retain key material; operations require customer-signed grant for emergency key usage."

ops-bot: uploaded document: /docs/poc/novahealth/peering-sample.yaml (link) :white_check_mark:

amy: Action items: @mike publish the Q/A and the peering snippet to the customer-facing folder and ping NovaHealth ops. @raj draft the KMS attestation and send to their CISO with cc to legal. @jessica confirm the discount ceiling by 17:00 PST Mon so I can push back to the buyer. I'll coordinate timeline — thank you all.

jessica: Got it. I'll confirm by EOD Mon. :thumbsup:
